صُوَّاحَةٌ , like رُمَّانَةٌ, [but accord. to analogy it
should be without teshdeed, like سُقَاطَةٌ &c., and so it is written in the L as relating to wool,] What has become much split, of hair, and what has fallen off and become scattered, thereof, (K,) and so of wool. (L, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
